ROUTE: Curlew-235B
REASON: Curlew holds higher or tied scores on the relevant capability dimensions for this evidence-citation task—Extraction & Retrieval (83.6 vs 81.6, effectively a tie) plus clear leads on instruction-following (IFEval 89.3 vs 85.6) and general reasoning benchmarks (MMLU-Pro, GPQA, Arena-Hard). No preference factors weighed against Curlew, so I routed to the higher-capability model.
